work.note: A referência é a peça em que Godot nunca vem, um plano cancelado. Em Esperando Godot, o personagem que dá nome à peça nunca aparece. facts.label: Passado simples e superlativos
facts.sub: Conte a partida no passado e use superlativos: It was the best match of my life. She was the tallest player. It was the most exciting game.

facts.label: Superlativo curto
facts.sub: Com adjetivos curtos, use the + adjetivo-est: tall → the tallest, long → the longest, hard → the hardest. Diga She was the tallest player in the club.

facts.label: Superlativo longo
facts.sub: Com adjetivos longos, use the most + adjetivo: the most exciting, the most difficult. Não diga excitingest. Diga It was the most exciting game.

facts.label: Irregulares
facts.sub: Alguns superlativos são irregulares: good vira the best e bad vira the worst. Diga It was the best match of my life e That was the worst moment.

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para contar a partida, use o passado simples: I won, I dropped my racket, it was. Perguntas usam did + verbo base: Did you serve well? Who did you play?

compare.us: Em inglês: the + adjetivo-est (the tallest) ou the most + adjetivo longo (the most exciting). Diga She was the tallest player.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Tallest is the superlative of tall.
The best is the superlative of good.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

pages.title: A sports club · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday afternoon at a sports club in Brisbane. The sun is bright over the green field. Next to the field, a tennis court is still wet. Lia sits near the net with her racket. Her friend Vera comes with a cold drink. She asks about the match.
“Hi, Lia! How was your tennis match?” says Vera. “It was the best match of my life! I won in three sets.” says Lia. “Well done! Who did you play?” says Vera.
